notes_for_editor: Single source for the tower: the tnlandforms Georgia list (entry GA336, page revision dated 2016 on the page itself, retrieved 2026-10-04). Two web searches and the cached NHLR and FFLOS pages gave no build, staffing, fire or status source; the story says so. The NHLR Georgia page is an undated crawl, so re-check nhlr.org/lookouts/us/ga/ before publishing the absence claim. On 2026-10-21 the cached page's 29 listed names were read in full and none matches Peek's Crossing or peeks crossing. The list spells it 'peeks crossing'; the history center spells its whistle stop 'Peek's Crossing' and no source links that stop to the tower. The list's 'tower' kind is not confirmed as a fire lookout, and lowercase-name entries carry unexplained notes. Coordinates and elevation agree with the record. No corrections; no photos found.
